command:
lsusb; lsusb -t; ls -l /dev/video* /dev/media* /dev/v4l-subdev* /dev/snd /dev/fb* /dev/dri /dev/i2c-* /dev/spidev* /dev/gpiochip* /dev/pwm*; cat /proc/asound/cards /proc/asound/pcm; arecord -l; aplay -l; v4l2-ctl --list-devices; for d in /sys/class/drm/card*-*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; cat "$d/status" "$d/enabled" "$d/modes"; done; for d in /sys/class/pwm/pwmchip*; do printf "
%s
" "$d"; readlink -f "$d/device"; cat "$d/npwm"; ls "$d"; done; ls -l /sys/bus/i2c/devices
